sloka: विभज्य सततम् वीर स राजा हरिसत्तम ।हित्वा धर्मम् तथा अर्थम् च कामम् यः तु निषेवते ॥४-३८-२१॥
transliteration: vibhajya satatam vīra sa rājā harisattama ।hitvā dharmam tathā artham ca kāmam yaḥ tu niṣevate ॥4-38-21॥

translations.english: 'One who neglects dharma and artha and pursues only kama (sensuous enjoyment) is like a man asleep on top of the tree, waking up only to realize that he has fallen down.
